title: 第十八章 回归-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    看着哥布林首领连衣服都顾不上穿，就这么慌慌张张的往外面跑，爻雪感觉自己的眼睛受到了侮辱，但她又没办法不看，因为这该死的哥布林首领就连逃跑都不忘带着那个镶嵌着秘境核心的手杖。

    见状，爻雪的眼中闪过一道精光，下一秒，一个电视机大小的结界出现在哥布林首领的头顶，将他的脑袋给禁锢得死死的，同时还抽空了里面的空气。

    将一个将近两米的结界内部变成真空对她来说或许还比较困难，但是只是一个电视机大小的结界，那就没什么问题了。

    果然，就在结界里面的空气被抽空的瞬间，哥布林首领感受到窒息的恐惧，双手不断地想要将自己脑袋上的这个东西弄走，然而，他越是激动，身体缺氧的状态就越严重。

    她应该庆幸，这些哥布林也是需要呼吸的，要不然她的结界效果不会这么好。

    趁着周围没人之际，爻雪以最快的速度冲进房子，然后将手杖从地上捡起来，转身就跑。

    此时大多数哥布林都在忙着逃跑或者灭火，根本就没有人注意到她这边的情况。

    从系统仓库中将早就准备好的电动车放出来，然后她就骑着电动车一路狂奔，此时的她也顾不得这样做会不会引来哥布林或者是秘境里面的其他生物了，反正现在秘境核心在她的手里，她就相当于拥有了这个秘境大门的钥匙。

    虽然这个秘境现在还不属于她，但总有一天，这个秘境会属于她的。

    好在这一路上都十分的顺利，并没有遇到什么危险，从秘境里面出来之后，爻雪没有任何的犹豫，立刻就利用秘境核心将秘境关闭。

    秘境核心除了能够控制秘境大门的关闭和打开之外，还能够控制秘境开启的位置。

    也就是说，如果下一次爻雪想要再次进入这个秘境，就不需要再跑到这边来了。

    从秘境里面出来之后，发现外面也是晚上，周围还有不少怪物正在游荡。

    这些怪物在听到电动车的动静之后，迅速朝着这边聚集而来，见状，爻雪眼疾手快，将自己和电动车用结界保护起来。

    这些怪物在失去了目标之后，再次恢复到了之前漫无目的游荡的状态。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Seeing the goblin leader not even bothering to put on his clothes and just running outside in such a panic, Yaoxue felt her eyes were insulted, but she couldn't help but look at it, because the damn goblin leader didn't forget to take the cane with the core of the secret realm with him even when he ran away.

Seeing this, a light flashed in Yaoxue's eyes, and the next second, a barrier the size of a television appeared above the head of the Goblin leader, imprisoning his head and sucking out the air inside.

It may be difficult for her to turn the inside of a nearly two-meter barrier into a vacuum, but if it is only a television-sized barrier, then there will be no problem.

Sure enough, at the moment when the air in the barrier was evacuated, the Goblin leader felt the fear of suffocation, and his hands kept trying to get this thing off his head. However, the more excited he was, the more serious his body's lack of oxygen became.

She should be lucky that these goblins also need to breathe, otherwise the effect of her barrier would not be so good.

When no one was around, Yaoxue rushed into the house as quickly as possible, picked up the cane from the ground, turned around and ran away.

At this time, most of the goblins were busy escaping or putting out the fire, and no one noticed the situation on her side.

She released the electric car that had been prepared for a long time from the system warehouse, and then she rode the electric car all the way. At this time, she did not care whether it would attract goblins or other creatures in the secret realm. Anyway, now that the core of the secret realm was in her hands, she was equivalent to having the key to the secret realm door.

Although this secret realm does not belong to her yet, one day, this secret realm will belong to her.

Fortunately, the journey went very smoothly and did not encounter any danger. After coming out of the secret realm, Yaoxue did not hesitate and immediately used the core of the secret realm to close the secret realm.

In addition to controlling the closing and opening of the secret realm door, the core of the secret realm can also control the location where the secret realm opens.

In other words, if Yaoxue wants to enter this secret realm again next time, there is no need to come here again.

After coming out of the secret realm, I found that it was also night outside and there were many monsters wandering around.

After hearing the movement of the electric car, these monsters quickly gathered here. Seeing this, Yaoxue used quick eyes and hands to protect herself and the electric car with a barrier.

After losing their target, these monsters returned to their previous state of wandering aimlessly.
